tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(mission): route lint's inputs-not-in-write-set check through PathContainedBy

lintInputsNotInWriteSet compared write_set entries as literal strings
gated by strings.HasSuffix(w, "/"). A glob entry like docs/** never
ends in "/", so the guard short-circuited before HasPrefix ever ran,
and a file it genuinely covers (docs/audited-delegation.md) drew a
spurious "not in write_set" advisory (ethos-8ady). Replace the literal
comparison with PathContainedBy, the same path-semantic containment
primitive write-set admission uses, per docs/spec-writeset-admission.tex's
8ady-fixed model.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <[redacted-email]>
EOF
)"
